translations.seo.home.title: Mobile home and bungalow rentals at CHM Montalivet and Euronat
translations.seo.home.description: Rent a bungalow, mobile home, caravan, chalet or studio at CHM Montalivet and Euronat, two naturist resorts. Calendars kept up to date by the owners, reply within 48 hours, no commission.
translations.seo.org.description: Connecting owners and guests for bungalows, mobile homes, caravans, chalets and studios at CHM Montalivet and Euronat. No commission.
translations.how.2: Cap Monta brings together private rentals at CHM Montalivet and Euronat on a single calendar. You search, you see the free dates, you write to the owner. That's all.
translations.how.3: You are looking for a rental
translations.how.5: Resort, area, dates, number of guests. Homes already taken for your dates are not shown.
translations.how.7: On each listing, the availability calendar and the rates by period are shown as the owner keeps them up to date.
translations.how.9: The form calculates the price of the stay and passes your request to the owner. The owner replies and decides.
translations.how.10: {$START_TAG_STRONG}A request is not a booking.{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} No payment goes through Cap Monta: the price, the deposit, the contract and the security deposit are settled directly with the owner. Until the owner accepts your request, the stay is not reserved.
translations.how.13: Photos, capacity, amenities, rates by period. If you already have a listing elsewhere, its text is enough to prefill the page.
translations.how.15: You block your own weeks and those already rented. An up-to-date calendar is what brings your listing up and avoids pointless requests.
translations.how.17: Each request comes with the dates, the number of guests and the calculated amount. You accept or decline; accepting blocks the dates automatically.
translations.how.18: Publishing is free and Cap Monta takes no commission on your rentals.
translations.how.21: An independent site, not affiliated with the management of CHM Montalivet or Euronat. The homes are offered by their owners, not by the resorts.
translations.how.23: It is what the owner has entered. The date of the last update is shown on each listing: that is the signal to check before planning around a period.
translations.how.24: Does the departure day count as a night?
translations.how.25: No. A stay from 8 to 15 August is seven nights: the arrival day counts, the departure day does not. The calendar and the price calculation follow the same rule.
translations.how.27: It is sent to the owner of the home, with your contact details, so that they can reply. How this is handled is described in the {$START_LINK}privacy policy{$CLOSE_LINK} (in French).
translations.how.32: By donations. The site has no advertising and takes no commission; the server costs about €8 a month.
translations.how.28: Can I buy or sell a mobile home here?
translations.how.29: No. Cap Monta only does holiday rentals, on purpose.
translations.seo.how.description: Renting a mobile home or bungalow at CHM Montalivet or Euronat with Cap Monta: up-to-date availability calendar, request sent straight to the owner, no commission.

translations.owner.guide.title: Publish your home, step by step
translations.owner.guide.lead: Allow 10 minutes, on a computer or a phone. Have the text of your current listing ready (Leboncoin, another site, a Facebook group…) and a few photos of the home, with no people in them.
translations.owner.guide.step-account-text: On the {$START_LINK}Create an owner account{$CLOSE_LINK} page, enter the name shown on your listing (for example “Martin family”), your email address and a password of at least 10 characters, then click {$START_TAG_STRONG}Create my account{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}.
translations.owner.guide.step-confirm-email-text: You receive an email “Confirm your address — Cap Monta”. Click its link. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive. Without this step, you can prepare everything, but not publish.
translations.owner.guide.step-paste-text: In {$START_TAG_STRONG}My space → My homes{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, click {$START_TAG_STRONG}Paste its text{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} (or {$START_TAG_STRONG}Import an existing listing{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} if you already have a home), paste the whole text of your listing, then click {$START_TAG_STRONG}Read my listing{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}. The home, the rates and the dates already taken are filled in for you. No existing listing? Click {$START_TAG_STRONG}+ Add my first home{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} instead and fill in the form.
translations.owner.guide.step-check-title: Check what has been filled in
translations.owner.guide.step-check-text: Your text stays on screen so you can compare. Check above all the {$START_TAG_STRONG}capacity{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} (required), the {$START_TAG_STRONG}area{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} at the CHM (needed to publish) or the {$START_TAG_STRONG}sector{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} at Euronat (optional), your {$START_TAG_STRONG}rates{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} ({$START_TAG_STRONG}+ Add a period{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} to add more, winter included) and the {$START_TAG_STRONG}dates already taken{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} ({$START_TAG_STRONG}+ Add taken dates{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}). Nothing is made up: whatever your listing does not say is left for you to fill in. Then click {$START_TAG_STRONG}Create the draft{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}.
translations.owner.guide.step-photos-text: You land on your home's page. In {$START_TAG_STRONG}Photos{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, first tick {$START_TAG_STRONG}No people appear in these photos{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, then drag your photos in or choose them from your device: 12 at most, 10 MB at most each, in JPEG, PNG or WebP. The first one is the cover. Read through the description (a few sentences), then click {$START_TAG_STRONG}Save the draft{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}.
translations.owner.guide.step-publish-text: In {$START_TAG_STRONG}My space → My homes{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, click {$START_TAG_STRONG}Publish{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}. Your home appears in search straight away, with its free weeks.
translations.owner.guide.blocked-unverified-text: Click the link in the email you received when you signed up. Email gone? In {$START_TAG_STRONG}My space{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, click {$START_TAG_STRONG}Resend the link{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}.
translations.owner.guide.blocked-capacity-text: Set the number of people with the − and + buttons under {$START_TAG_STRONG}Capacity{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}.
translations.owner.guide.blocked-district-text: At the CHM, choose it from the {$START_TAG_STRONG}Area{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} list on the home's page.
translations.owner.guide.blocked-description-title: “Add a description of at least 50 characters”
translations.owner.guide.blocked-description-text: Two or three sentences are enough: the home, the location, what makes it special.
translations.owner.guide.blocked-contact-title: “Remove … from this text: it is public”
translations.owner.guide.blocked-contact-text: Your description contains a phone number or an email address. Remove them: guests write to you through a request, and your phone number (in {$START_TAG_STRONG}My profile{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}) is only given to the guest whose request you accept.
translations.owner.guide.blocked-no-rates-title: “No rates were found in your listing”
translations.owner.guide.blocked-no-rates-text: That's normal if your listing gives no prices. Add your periods with {$START_TAG_STRONG}+ Add a period{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, now or later in {$START_TAG_STRONG}Rates{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}.
translations.owner.guide.blocked-photo-size-text: Send the photo to yourself by email or by message from your phone: it arrives smaller. Then add that version.
translations.owner.guide.online-requests-text: With the dates, the number of people and the price. In {$START_TAG_STRONG}My space{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, click {$START_TAG_STRONG}Reply{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, then {$START_TAG_STRONG}Accept{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} or {$START_TAG_STRONG}Decline{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}. With no reply within 48 hours, the request expires and the guest is told.
translations.owner.guide.online-phone-title: Your phone number, for the accepted guest
translations.owner.guide.online-phone-text: Add it in {$START_TAG_STRONG}My space → My profile{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}. It is only given to the guest whose request you accept, never shown on the listing.
translations.owner.guide.online-calendar-title: Your calendar stays up to date
translations.owner.guide.online-calendar-text: An accepted request blocks its dates by itself. A week rented elsewhere? Block it in {$START_TAG_STRONG}Calendar{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG}, so you don't get requests for it.
translations.owner.guide.online-control-text: Rates, photos and description can be changed at any time. {$START_TAG_STRONG}Remove from the site{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} pauses the listing, {$START_TAG_STRONG}Put back online{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} publishes it again.

translations.owner.guide.seo-title: Publish your home step by step
translations.owner.guide.seo-description: From account to going online in 10 minutes: import your existing listing, check rates and dates, add your photos, publish. And what to do if a message stops you.
translations.owner.landing.title: Rent out your home at CHM Montalivet or Euronat
translations.owner.landing.lead: List your bungalow, mobile home, caravan, chalet or studio on Cap Monta. Free, with no commission, and with a calendar guests see before they write to you.
translations.owner.landing.why-commission-text: The price you show is the price you receive. Cap Monta takes nothing.
translations.owner.landing.why-calendar-text: Your free weeks show up right on the results page. No more “is it still available?” messages for dates already taken.
translations.owner.landing.why-control-text: You set your rates by period, you accept or decline each request. No booking is confirmed without you.
translations.owner.landing.step-account-text: Two minutes, and an email to confirm your address.
translations.owner.landing.step-describe-text: Paste the text of your current listing: home, rates and taken dates are filled in for you, you check them. The text stays yours.
translations.owner.landing.step-calendar-text: You block the booked weeks and publish your rates by period.
translations.owner.landing.step-reply-text: Each request arrives by email with the dates and the number of people.
translations.owner.landing.guide-link: Every button and every message explained: {$START_LINK}the step-by-step guide{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.owner.landing.not-title: What Cap Monta does not do
translations.owner.landing.not-payment: {$START_TAG_STRONG}We do not take any payment.{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} You agree on payment and the deposit directly with the guest, as you already do.
translations.owner.landing.not-contract: {$START_TAG_STRONG}We are not a party to the rental agreement.{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} It binds you to the guest, not to us.
translations.owner.landing.not-affiliated: {$START_TAG_STRONG}We are not linked to the management of CHM Montalivet or of Euronat.{$CLOSE_TAG_STRONG} Cap Monta is an independent site.
translations.owner.landing.faq-cost-q: How much does it cost to publish a listing?
translations.owner.landing.faq-cost-a: Nothing. No subscription, no commission on your rentals.
translations.owner.landing.faq-domains-q: Do you need to be an owner at CHM Montalivet or Euronat?
translations.owner.landing.faq-domains-a: Yes. Cap Monta only lists these two resorts, and that's deliberate: a site that knows the areas, the distances to the beach and the local customs is more useful than a general directory.
translations.owner.landing.faq-several-a: Yes. One account manages as many homes and calendars as you need.

translations.owner.landing.seo-description: List your bungalow, mobile home, caravan, chalet or studio for free. No commission, an up-to-date calendar, and you stay in control of your rates and your replies.
